<script type="text/javascript">
        var masterViewModel = new masterVm.viewmodel('/search.aspx');
        masterViewModel.init();
	  var MainVMfn = new MainVM.EnrVM();
		MainVMfn.Init();

		var cookiePromptContainerId = '#section-cookie';
		var acceptCookieName = 'usrcookie';
		$('#btn-cookies-accept').click(function () {
		    var d = new Date();
		    d.setTime(d.getTime() + (1200 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
		    var expires = 'expires=' + d.toGMTString();
		    document.cookie = acceptCookieName + '=' + 'unfcu123' + ';' + expires + ';path=/';
		    $(cookiePromptContainerId).fadeOut();
		});
		var decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
		if (decodedCookie.indexOf(acceptCookieName) <= 0) {
		    $(cookiePromptContainerId).fadeIn();
		}
		else { $(cookiePromptContainerId).fadeOut(); }

    </script>
